name.value: Best Western Premier Prestige Oceanfront Resort

description.value: A five-storey oceanfront resort framed by the waters of Sooke Harbour, offering panoramic coastal views and coastal-inspired décor in the small town of Sooke on Vancouver Island's southwestern tip. Part of the WorldHotels Luxury collection within the Best Western Premier brand, it sits along the West Coast Road — a scenic cycling corridor connecting Sooke to the Juan de Fuca Trail trailheads. Touring cyclists finishing or starting multi-day routes in the area will find a full-service hotel option at this location.

address.value: 6929 West Coast Road, Sooke, BC V9Z 0V1

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms the hotel at 6929 West Coast Road, Sooke, BC with the same address as OSM, and the booking page is active, confirming the business is open. The amenity icons ('free-breakfast', 'free-high-speed-internet') appear identically across multiple Best Western site pages (property page, customer service, affiliate), indicating they are site-wide navigation elements rather than property-specific confirmed amenities — only the OSM tag internet_access=wlan reliably confirms Wi-Fi. No bike-specific services (storage, tools, wash, e-bike charging) are mentioned anywhere in the website content.
concerns: The amenity icons appearing in the page header ('free-breakfast', 'free-high-speed-internet', etc.) are replicated identically on non-property pages (customer service, affiliate pages), suggesting they are site-wide navigation filters rather than confirmed amenities for this specific property — treat with caution.

The hotel's direct phone number is not displayed in the scraped website content; only the central reservations number (1-800-780-7234) is shown, so the OSM phone +1-250-642-0805 could not be confirmed via website.
The OSM URL points to the Best Western central booking system rather than a dedicated hotel website, which limits the depth of property-specific information available.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: A real, active, publicly accessible hotel on the West Coast Road cycling corridor near Sooke; booking page is live and the property is confirmed open.
enrichment_extras.notes: The hotel is also marketed under the WorldHotels Luxury brand (per the page title 'Prestige Oceanfront Resort, WorldHotels Luxury'), which may be the more current brand identity. Cyclists should contact the hotel directly to ask about bike storage arrangements.
